mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.processing_status='RECEIVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.processing_status='RETRY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) retryCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.processing_status='CONFLICT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) conflictCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos_sync_dead_letter d JOIN pos_sync_inbox di ON di.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND di.event_id=d.event_id JOIN pos_sync_device dd ON dd.tenant_id=di.tenant_id AND dd.device_id=di.device_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dd.store_id=#{storeId} AND d.status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING')) deadLetterCount, COALESCE(MAX(i.device_sequence),0) maximumDeviceSequence, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.processing_status='APPLIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) appliedCount FROM pos_sync_device d LEFT JOIN pos_sync_inbox i ON i.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND i.device_id=d.device_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.store_id=#{storeId}
